strengths: Significant practical contribution: 40x speedup with 30% tighter intervals over Gibbs et al. (2023), addressing real computational bottleneck
Novel algorithmic approach: Elegant solution-path algorithm exploiting piecewise-linear structure in λ and S, avoiding repeated full optimizations
Principled high-dimensional extension: Well-motivated integration of low-rank latent embeddings with proper handling of symmetric computation requirement
Solid theoretical framework: Theorems 1-2 appropriately adapt to latent space; Assumptions 1-2 are reasonable; error analysis (Lemmas 7-10) is thorough
Comprehensive experiments: Diverse applications (synthetic, molecular, text, medical) with multiple baselines and detailed metrics
Reproducibility: Code released as Python package; detailed algorithmic descriptions enable reproduction
Honest limitations discussion: Section 4 appropriately acknowledges limitations (fixed α, unweighted quantile loss) without overclaiming
weaknesses: Weakened coverage guarantees in latent space: Theorem 1's error term E[∑υ̂ψ*_W]/E[ψ*_W] is unbounded in principle; paper claims it's 'measurable' but provides no bounds, magnitudes, or guidance on when small—concerning for stated conditional validity
Coverage guarantee gaps under embedding error: Lemma 10 shows error depends on embedding perturbation Δ(w'), which could be substantial in high dimensions, but no empirical estimates provided

Inconsistent theoretical treatment: Theorem 1 vs 2 have different assumptions (i.i.d. vs exchangeability, density kernel requirement); implications unclear. Assumption 3-4 for Proposition 4 are stronger than original Gibbs et al. but not discussed in main text

Concerning experimental results: ArXiv ML topic achieves 0.730 ± 0.34 coverage (target 0.90)—far from nominal with high variance; no diagnostic analysis of failure mode. Standard deviations sometimes large (up to 0.34), raising robustness questions

Limited scalability and complexity analysis: Largest calibration n=2400; no scaling analysis to n=50K+. Expected |E| and number of events not analyzed; claimed O((|E|+d)³) with |E|≪n but no empirical validation

Algorithm initialization and tuning: λ¹ initialization (Eq. 39) appears ad-hoc with arbitrary j* choice; sensitivity not analyzed. Hyperparameter grid for γ not specified; sensitivity to resolution unexplored

Presentation and clarity: Dense notation in Sections 2.1.2-2.1.3 reduces accessibility. Important results (Lemmas 3-4) relegated to appendix. Distinction between path existence and efficient computation could be clearer
Incomplete experimental details: Missing specifics on random seeds, pLSI convergence criteria, kernel matrix conditioning effects. No ablation studies on λ vs S paths or different kernel choices

Gap between claimed and actual guarantees: Shift from P(Y∈Ĉ|X) to P(Y∈Ĉ|π̂(X)) acknowledged as 'different notion of conditional coverage' but implications not fully explored; represents meaningful weakening
